page_title: Get your brand mentioned by AI | Parse

sources.entry: Parse - AI visibility analytics for tracking brand mentions, competitors, and cited sources across ChatGPT and Google AI Overviews.

summary.name: Parse
summary.one_liner: Parse is an AI visibility service that tracks how often brands are mentioned in ChatGPT and Google AI Mode answers and handles outreach to improve that visibility.
use_cases: track how often ChatGPT mentions your brand
compare brand mentions against competitors in AI answers
find which sources AI cites about your market
get listed on comparison articles that AI reads
summary.what_it_does: The page describes tracking brand mentions in ChatGPT and Google AI Mode, asking both the same buyer questions and counting each answer. It reports the percentage of tracked answers that mention a brand, plus recommended-for and criticism points for each brand. It shows competitor comparisons across topics, such as Kubernetes monitoring, and lists the sites AI cites. It also finds opportunities in a market and has outreach handled for the user, with follow-ups.
notable: Tracks brand mentions in ChatGPT and Google AI Mode, with 11 AI sources tracked per the page
Managed outreach: finds listing and citation opportunities and follows up on the user's behalf
Free tier tracks one brand with weekly updates; Pro is $79 a month per brand
caveats: Pro plan costs $79 a month per brand
Free topics are asked on ChatGPT only; Google AI Mode coverage requires a higher tier
Share-of-answers figures need at least 20 answers before the workspace shows a number
